covers_note.en: One Schengen visa covers all 29 countries: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland.

application.address: Apply at the embassy/VFS of the country where you'll spend the most time (or first entry). Most route through VFS Global Yangon.

notes.en: A Schengen visa is required. Apply at the embassy/VFS of your main destination (where you'll spend the most nights). One visa grants access to all 29 Schengen countries. Note: UK and Ireland are NOT in Schengen and need separate visas. ETIAS (a separate €20 authorization) is expected to launch later.
notes.my: Schengen ဗီဇာ လိုအပ်သည်။ သင့်အဓိကသွားရောက်မည့်နိုင်ငံ (ညအများဆုံးနေမည့်) ၏ သံရုံး/VFS တွင် လျှောက်ထားပါ။ ဗီဇာတစ်ခုဖြင့် Schengen နိုင်ငံ ၂၉ ခုလုံး ဝင်ရောက်နိုင်။ မှတ်ချက်: ယူကေနှင့် အိုင်ယာလန်သည် Schengen တွင်မပါ၊ သီးခြားဗီဇာလို။

notes.en: A Standard Visitor visa is required. Apply online then attend the UK Visa Application Centre (VFS Global) in Yangon for biometrics. Fee ~£115 for up to 6 months.

notes.en: Visa-free up to 30 days under the Russia–Myanmar mutual visa exemption agreement (effective 27 Jan 2026), for ordinary passport holders travelling for tourism. Does not cover study, work, or residency.
